# Version 4.150.0
> **Skia m150 and new APIs** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates the rendering engine to Skia m150 and expands image, color, and paint APIs. The release also improves repeated SKSurface canvas access, corrects small-sigma raster blurs, and completes the pre-v4 API cleanup.

## Breaking Changes

- **Remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs are now errors** — APIs that remained obsolete from before v4 now produce compile errors, and obsolete enums are absent from the reference assembly. Migrate callers to the replacement APIs identified by their obsolete messages before upgrading. ([#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195))
- **.NET Interactive support removed** — The deprecated .NET Interactive and Polyglot Notebooks integration is no longer shipped. Remove dependencies on that integration or move notebook rendering to an application-owned SkiaSharp display path. ([#4186](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4186))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone 150** — Moves the bundled renderer to the m150 release line and includes a subsequent round of upstream m150 bug fixes. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146), [#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## API Surface

- **Image and color filter creation expanded** — Adds empty and crop image filters plus an overdraw color filter for composing filter graphs and visualizing overdraw. ([#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228), [#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229), [#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227))
- **Fast paint bounds exposed** — Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds() so callers can cheaply estimate draw bounds for quick-reject culling. ([#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271))

## Bug Fixes

- **Small raster blurs render correctly** — Restores expected output for small-sigma raster blurs that regressed on the m150 line. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKSurface canvas access is faster** — Caches the managed Canvas wrapper across calls, avoiding repeated wrapper creation while preserving the surface-owned canvas lifecycle. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## Security

- **HarfBuzz updated to 14.2.1** — Refreshes the bundled text-shaping dependency used by HarfBuzzSharp. ([#4167](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4167))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz text-shaping engine to 14.2.1.
